notes: Very thin run: web search surfaced almost no clinic own-sites for Zimbabwe. Only the University of Zimbabwe page was an official/own source and usable. Not published (aggregator/directory only): Bulawayo SPCA clinic (Khami Rd, 0778547331, zimplaza.co.zw); Harare SPCA clinic (2 Airport Rd, Hatfield, 0712 211 900, (0242) 576 356/7; own site spca.org.zw refused PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Candidate names seen only in search results as directory listings, not opened/verified: Borrowdale Vet Surgery (VetClick), Avondale Veterinary Surgery and Harare Central Vet (thedirectory.co.zw - fetch rate-limited), medpages.info vet listing. Zimbabwe Veterinary Association / Veterinary Council of Zimbabwe / Dept of Veterinary Services: no directory page found via search. Nothing found for Bulawayo, Victoria Falls, Mutare, Gweru private clinics. No 24 h clinics verified, no duty rotas, no animal poison line found. Needs own-site verification in a later run.
